_about: Hand-written pin, not captured from production: what GET /bus/schedule/data/:serviceId/smart, GET /bus/stops/:stopId/arrivals and GET /bus/live/:groupId answered in ko, en and zh at commit 90146c04 (2026-10-24), before the live mappers produced stop calls and the stop page read shuttle runs (docs/plans/7800-unified-arrivals.md §7), over the stores stop-calls-characterization.routes.test.ts seeds, at each of its instants. An en or zh answer whose bytes are the ko answer's with only meta.lang changed is stored as its ETag beside sameBodyAs: ko. Changed on purpose twice since: every vehicle gained seatsLeft (ADR 0019, D17), null here since no GBIS answer is stored, right after occupancy, and Express's weak ETag of the 39 answers whose bytes changed (HSSC live and stop pages) moved with them; then each stop page's stop gained stopAreaId (ADR 0022, D4), null here since no stop area is stored, after its other fields, and the weak ETag of those 91 answers moved with it; then every pole's stop id became its national station id instead of seoul-<ARS> (owner, 2026-10-25; ADR 0019, D5), in 종로02's and 종로07's live stations and the stop page of seoul-01619, now requested as 100000424, and the weak ETag of those 9 answers moved with it; nothing else changed.
